variant.briefing:
Hey,

I’ve been tracking Headhunters activity at [Location]. Recently, they stocked it with supplies we believe were stolen from one of our cargo convoys. [TargetName] offered to go get our goods back but hasn’t checked in since. Really need to know what happened to them and if our supplies are there.

Think this is something you could handle? You’ll probably have to deal with Headhunters forces to get to the bottom of this. Also, any goods you grab should go to [Destination] once you’re out of there.

Thanks, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
